enchantments.tooltip: Radiance Lore +14: Passive: Your Light and Aligned spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Radiance +97: Passive: +97 Equipment bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Shield +8: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +8 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
